title: LTESM-C Expansion Powidz, Poland
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTH ATLANTIC.ENDIST EUROPE.W2SD ENDIST EUROPE
detail_text: This is a Sources Sought announcement for market research purposes for the Long Term Equipment Storage and Maintenance-Complex (LTESM-C) Expansion project at Powidz Air Base, Poland.The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) anticipates a stand-alone, Design-Build (DB), Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) contract to construct several new support facilities, including a large-scale humidity-controlled warehouse and a vehicle maintenance facility. The anticipated magnitude of construction is between $100,000,000 and $250,000,000. This acquisition is open to all eligible firms registered and incorporated in a North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) member nation.This notice is a summary only. For complete project details, submission requirements, and response instructions, please download and review the full Sources Sought announcement attached to this posting.
